baseline_profile.workload: Plus, eight labelled 120x120 keys, looping 100 FPS GIF, requested DejaVu Sans (missing-family fallback)
baseline_profile.method: perf record -F 4999 -e cycles:u --call-graph dwarf,8192; 15-second warmup, separate 20-second profile

memory_maps.workload: Plus, all eight labelled 120x120 keys, looping 100 FPS GIF, installed Liberation Sans
memory_maps.method: Separate fresh HOME/private D-Bus background runs; /proc/PID/smaps grouped at 15 and 30 seconds. No CPU benchmark claim.
memory_maps.finding: New mapped application image +0.39453125 MiB; anonymous heap -0.0390625 MiB. Both are stable between the two snapshots. This diagnostic explains a small code footprint cost, not a heap growth trend or a long-duration leak claim.
